title: finding(components): `KbdGroup` changeset under-declared the published `.d.ts` move — `ComponentRef<typeof KbdGroup>` `HTMLDivElement → HTMLElement` shipped as `patch` with a false "nothing stops compiling" note (residue of objectui#8891 / #8576)
body:
objectui#8891 (merged 2026-09-10T04:38Z, head `2fb8993215`, `Fixes #8576`) changed `KbdGroup`'s props type from `React.ComponentProps<"div">` to `React.ComponentProps<"kbd">` (`packages/components/src/custom/kbd.tsx:26`). The code, ratchet and tests are right. What shipped wrong is the **published record**:

- `.changeset/kbd-group-props-name-the-element-8576.md` declared `patch` and states "everything that type-checked before still type-checks … the deprecated `align` … is the only shape that moves". Measured with the tree's toolchain (typescript 6.0.3 / @types/react 19.2.18): `React.ComponentRef<typeof KbdGroup>` moves `HTMLDivElement → HTMLElement`, and four consumer shapes that compiled stop compiling — a wrapper forwarding `ComponentProps<typeof KbdGroup>` onto a real `<div>` (TS2322 on `ref`), `useRef<ComponentRef<typeof KbdGroup>>` then `.current.align` (TS2339), passing that `ref.current` to an `HTMLDivElement`-typed sink (TS2345), `onClick={e => e.currentTarget.align}` (TS2339). Two of those do not touch `align` at all.
- Per AGENTS.md:240 and this package's own precedent (`packages/components/CHANGELOG.md:434` / `:481`, PR #4651: "Breaking for TypeScript authors … marked `minor`"), the level is `minor` with the FROM→TO consequence stated. The fixed group already bumped the version, so the **CHANGELOG entry** is the defect: it tells authors nothing moves.
- The same over-claim sits in the PR body ("Premise P1" bullet 2) and the test docblock `packages/components/src/custom/__tests__/kbd-group-props-name-the-element-8576.test.tsx:56-66`.

**Ask:** a docs-only follow-up that corrects the CHANGELOG entry for the released version (or the next release note) with the FROM→TO consequence, fixes the test docblock prose, and optionally adds `Assert<Equal<React.ComponentRef<typeof KbdGroup>, HTMLElement>>` as the pin the level turns on. Reference: director verdict https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/pull/8891#issuecomment-5610549511 (F1).

**Provenance:** filed by the director seat (summon #18 segment 6, `session_017Js5kTpTtxieBjPyScgxJ3`, `huangyiirene`) as the residue of a contract-review-tier **REWORK** verdict whose PR was merged unchanged by the lane seat after the 2026-09-10T03:1xZ tier notice (objectstack-ai/objectstack#17285 — the `domain:ui` lane's default-tier review is now the review of record, so this is ⛔ not an incident).
